name: EOGS (Earth-observation Gaussian Splatting)
aliases: Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Satellite Image Photogrammetry
definition: EOGS is a method for digital elevation modeling and appearance recovery from remote sensing images, adapting the standard 3DGS framework for satellite photogrammetry to achieve state-of-the-art performance with significantly faster training times (minutes vs. days).
summary: EOGS is a satellite photogrammetry method adapting 3D Gaussian Splatting for rapid digital elevation modeling, replacing complex RPC pipelines with affine approximations to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy in minutes.
